messages:
Clara: quick thread on provenance & cost accounting for compatibility shims. we need traceability from RFC -> shim -> billing.
Hao: agree. minimal metadata: dep_id, shim_id, owner, cost_center, billing_tag, created_ts, expires_ts. keep it tiny so automation is easy.
Zoe: runtime requirement: attach dep_id & shim_id to traces and metrics as tags so we can correlate diffs and costs. also emit shim_hit events from SDKs.
Marco: billing ask: pipeline must accept `shim_tag` and attribute infra costs to the declared owner/cost_center. produce a daily per-shim cost report.
billing-bot: system: billing ingestion updated to accept shim_tag at 7143219994.
Clara: governance: require owner budget approval for shims estimated > $100/day. store cost_estimate on creation.
Hao: feature: add `cost_throttle` option on shim entries. owners can set max daily spend and gateway will proportionally throttle shim traffic when approaching limit.
Zoe: observability: dashboard widget showing shim hits, cost/day, p95 delta, active tenants, and top callers. include a drilldown to sample diffs.
Marco: ops: if a shim's cost spikes unexpectedly, auto-mute the shim and page the owner after threshold X. also require a manual unmute.
Clara: actions: Hao -> add shim_tag support to billing pipeline (ETA 2d); Zoe -> wire trace+metric tags (ETA 3d); Marco -> alerting + mute flow (ETA 3d). I'll add budget approval to the shim catalog UI (ETA 2d).
Hao: noted. we'll also log `dep_id` in the BI events for cross-correlation.
Zoe: no objections. small experiment: enable cost_throttle for one staging shim and monitor.
Marco: sounds good. closing for now, will follow up with PRs.
